notes.title: The Adventures of Astel - Update 2.0.2.5
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

We have some amazing news to share about The Adventures of Astel! Until today, January 22, 2025, you've all embarked on this magical journey with the original version of our beloved protagonist. However, after listening closely to community feedback and conducting a market survey, we decided it was time for a big transformation.

Meet the new Astel!
Now featuring a more humanoid and playful design, perfectly aligned with the story, personality, and overall vibe of the game. This new version truly reflects the charming and vibrant style that you love, adding even more excitement to Astel’s magical universe.

This update also includes important code optimizations and bug fixes to ensure an even smoother and more enjoyable experience.

We’re thrilled for you to experience these changes and hope you love this new chapter as much as we loved creating it. As always, we value your feedback, so share your thoughts with us here on Steam!

Thank you for being part of this journey!
See you in The Adventures of Astel!
